intro: A commercial licence covers use of Conch inside a company. It is a licence, not a subscription to a service — there is no backend of ours for you to depend on, and nothing stops working if you stop paying: the licence simply lapses.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.for: A team that wants the licence squared away without a procurement cycle. Count the developers who actually open it.

tiers.name: Organisation
tiers.terms: unlimited developers within one legal entity
tiers.for: Cheaper than per-seat from roughly thirty developers, and it ends the seat-counting. One invoice, one renewal.

tiers.name: Redistribution
tiers.for: Shipping Conch to your own customers, embedding it in a product you sell, or putting it on a store under your own brand.

included: A written commercial licence from Eight 24 Family LLC covering internal business use.
Security questionnaires and vendor-onboarding paperwork answered by a human.
Distribution however suits you — Google Play, or the signed APK for your own managed-device channel.
A named contact for issues, and a say in what gets built next. The app collects nothing, so what you tell us is the only signal there is.
excluded: No uptime SLA. There is nothing hosted to have uptime — the app talks to your servers, and those are yours.
No 24/7 support desk. Conch is maintained by one developer; expect human-speed answers, not a rota.
No certifications. There is no SOC 2 or ISO 27001 report, and we will not imply otherwise. What there is instead: no backend to audit, no data received, and source you can read.
closing: Prices are in USD and exclude any tax your jurisdiction adds. Non-profits, education and government keep using it free under the noncommercial licence — that is not a discount to ask for, it already applies.
